items.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998
items.q: he and I used to talk a lot about that... When he passed away I was invited to conduct his orchestra.

ctx.x: But it was partly up to you?

It was really, you know when Ormandy — God rest his soul — when Eugene Ormandy was alive, he and I used to talk a lot about that, because he conducted at the Capitol Theater in New York, and he once mentioned something to me how he said, in Hungarian he wouldn’t say tampered, he acquired melodic content that didn’t belong in the film. And he said what the things that they sent for the theater orchestras to play, an orangutan could conduct. You know he said there was no interest in the music. So he began really to…
You’ve had some amazing friends and associates over the years, including I read that you studied with Schoenberg?
